_comment: Staking contracts read automatically on EVM chains (cryptoledger/adapters/evm_staking.py). type ronin_dpos: Ronin's staking contract (address from ronin-chain/dpos-contract, deployments/ronin-mainnet/StakingProxy.json). type stakewise_v3: StakeWise v3 vaults (MetaMask Pooled Staking is one); no address needed, vaults are found among the contracts the wallet sent ETH to.
